record.original_question: Let (X, X, µ, T) be a system and f, g ∈ L∞(µ). If Λ is the von Mangoldt function and φ is a multiplicative function with values in the closed unit disk that has convergent means, do the weighted averages (1/N) Σ Λ(n) f(T^n x) g(T^{2n} x) and (1/N) Σ φ(n) f(T^n x) g(T^{2n} x) converge pointwise almost everywhere?

evidence.quote: Problem 12. Let (X, X , µ, T) be a system and f, g ∈ L∞(µ) be functions. If Λ is the von Mangoldt function and φ is a multiplicative function that takes values on the complex unit disc and has convergent means, then show that the averages 1/N Σ Λ(n) f(T^n x) · g(T^2nx) and the averages 1/N Σ φ(n) f(T^n x) · g(T^2nx) converge pointwise almost everywhere.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,T)$ be a measure-preserving system, where $T:X\to X$ is an invertible measurable transformation preserving the probability measure $\mu$, and let $f,g\in L^{\infty}(\mu)$.

Recall the von Mangoldt function $\Lambda:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{R}$ defined by $\Lambda(n)=\log p$ if $n=p^k$ for some prime $p$ and integer $k\ge 1$, and $\Lambda(n)=0$ otherwise. Let $\varphi:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{C}$ be a multiplicative function (i.e. $\varphi(mn)=\varphi(m)\varphi(n)$ whenever $\gcd(m,n)=1$) taking values in the closed unit disc $\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|\le 1\}$, and assume that $\varphi$ has convergent means, i.e. the limit
$$\lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\varphi(n)$$
exists in $\mathbb{C}$.

Prove or disprove: for $\mu$-almost every $x\in X$, both of the weighted bilinear averages
$$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\Lambda(n)\,f(T^{n}x)\,g(T^{2n}x)\qquad\text{and}\qquad\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\varphi(n)\,f(T^{n}x)\,g(T^{2n}x)$$
converge as $N\to\infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (notably a 2025 preprint on pointwise convergence of polynomial multiple ergodic averages along the primes) establishes pointwise a.e. convergence of von Mangoldt-weighted multilinear averages along polynomials of pairwise distinct degrees. The bilinear case with iterates $T^n$ and $T^{2n}$ (both linear, hence of the same degree) is not covered by these results, and no result for general multiplicative weights with convergent means in this bilinear setting appears to be available. The problem therefore appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Pointwise convergence of polynomial multiple ergodic averages along the primes
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes pointwise a.e. convergence for von Mangoldt-weighted multiple ergodic averages along polynomials with integer coefficients and pairwise distinct degrees.
status_evidence.claim: The available pointwise result for prime/von Mangoldt weights requires distinct-degree polynomials, so it does not cover the bilinear T^n, T^{2n} case.

status_evidence.title: Pointwise convergence of ergodic averages with Möbius weight
status_evidence.snippet: Studies pointwise convergence of ergodic averages weighted by multiplicative (Möbius) functions; bilinear extensions remain limited.
status_evidence.claim: Pointwise convergence of bilinear averages with general multiplicative weights of convergent means is not established.
